title: Login Issue - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They've tried resetting their password multiple times but still can't access the dashboard.

title: Payment Failure - Order #2345
description: Customer reports that their payment for order #2345 is not processing. Tried multiple cards without success.

title: Feature Request - Dark Mode
description: Customer requested a dark mode option for the dashboard to reduce eye strain during night use.

title: App Crash on Startup - Android
description: Customer reports that the mobile app crashes immediately after opening on Android devices version 12 and above.

title: Incorrect Billing - Double Charge
description: Customer was charged twice for the monthly subscription. They request a refund for the extra charge.

title: Email Notification Delay
description: Customer reports delays in receiving email notifications after triggering important events on the platform.

title: Profile Picture Upload Fails
description: Customer is unable to upload their profile picture on the web app. Upload button shows no response.

title: Dashboard Slow Loading
description: Customer reports that dashboard pages take too long to load, especially when accessing reports with large datasets.

title: Password Reset Link Broken
description: Customer tried resetting their password, but the reset link redirects to a 404 page.

title: App Notifications - No Sound on iOS
description: Customer reports that notification sounds are not playing on iOS devices when receiving new messages.

title: Data Export Fails for Large Datasets
description: Customer attempts to export CSV files with large datasets, but the export process fails with an error.

title: Incorrect User Role Assignment
description: New users are being assigned incorrect roles upon registration, which restricts access to necessary features.
